prompt:
Create two coordinated mobile TripLOG pre-purchase input screens, one for flight tickets and one for accommodation. Match the compact design already used in TripLOG’s overview, expenses and reservation wallet: white background, original black TRIPLOG wordmark with a pink LOG box, dark ink #0b1020, lemon yellow #fff05a, sky blue #bce6fb and pale pink #f7afc7, thin dark borders, small offset shadows and simple outline icons. Use no destination photographs or decorative illustrations. Keep screen headings at 24px, section headings at 15px, labels at 12px, editable text at 16px, amount text at 22px and primary actions at 44px high.

Both screens have the logo and close control, “사전구매”, the subtitle “오사카·교토 가족여행”, and equal-width “항공권” and “숙소” tabs with the active tab in yellow. Clearly separate reservation information from payment information. Keep compact paired fields and comfortable touch targets.

Flight screen: select “항공권”. Include a small “편도 / 왕복” control with 왕복 selected. Under “항공편 정보”, show paired fields “항공사”, “제주항공” and “편명 (선택)”, “7C1301”; then “출발지”, “인천 ICN” and “도착지”, “오사카 KIX”, with a small swap action. Show compact paired date/time controls for “가는 날”, “9.25 금”, “출발 시간”, “09:10”, and for “오는 날”, “9.28 월”, “복귀 출발 시간”, “18:20”. Under “결제 정보”, display “총 결제 금액” and a compact dark-outlined amount row “327,700” with a fixed “KRW · 원” unit. Pair “결제일”, “9.15 화” with a compact “카드 / 현금” selector, selecting 카드 in yellow. Put “예약번호 · 메모 (선택)” inside a collapsed disclosure row. A short helper explains “지출 기록과 예약 지갑에 함께 저장돼요.” The fixed footer has “취소” and a yellow “항공권 저장”.

Accommodation screen: select “숙소”. Under “숙박 정보”, show “숙소명”, “난바 호텔”, then paired “체크인”, “9.25 금” and “체크아웃”, “9.28 월”. Include a small pink stay summary “3박 · 1박 평균 100,000원”. Under “결제 정보”, show “숙박 전체 결제 금액” and the same compact amount row “300,000”, “KRW · 원”, followed by “결제일”, “9.15 화” and “카드 / 현금”. Put “주소 · 예약번호 · 객실 · 메모 (선택)” inside an expandable row. Finish with the same helper and fixed “취소” / yellow “숙소 저장” footer. Use clear Korean text, efficient spacing, consistent controls and a polished composition that can be faithfully implemented as working forms.
